featured_reviews.name: RAVI SONI
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this college to take an exam and faced several issues. Firstly, there is no parking available for two-wheelers, which caused me some inconvenience. However, the main problem arose during the exam when I needed to use the washroom. All the washrooms were locked, and upon inquiry, I was informed that they are reserved exclusively for staff. My exam hall was on the 6th floor, and the security personnel directed me to the 1st floor to access a washroom. This process wasted at least 15 minutes of my exam time.

My simple question to the management is: if you cannot provide basic facilities like accessible washrooms for students, why do you designate your institution as an exam center? Students shouldn’t have to approach the admin office for such fundamental needs. Locking washrooms is unacceptable. I hope you address this issue promptly. When students come to your college for exams, they deserve basic amenities like drinking water at their desks and nearby washroom access. Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Tanveer Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a father of two children at Orchids International School - Kurla, my experience has been decent but with some concerns.

While the school has a good curriculum and infrastructure, there are areas that need improvement.

The Positives:

Qualified Teachers – Most teachers are caring and make efforts to engage students.

Good Facilities – The classrooms and playgrounds are well-maintained.

Extracurricular Activities – A decent variety of activities to keep kids interested.

Areas for Improvement:
Communication Gaps – Sometimes, updates about school events or academic progress are delayed or unclear.

Homework & Workload – My son often feels overwhelmed with assignments.

Limited Individual Attention

The school has potential but needs better communication, workload management, and more focus on individual student needs. Hoping for positive changes in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Hitesh Bhushan
featured_reviews.review_text:
S K Somaiya College, part of the prestigious Somaiya Vidyavihar University, is one of the best institutions in Mumbai for students seeking quality education, modern infrastructure, and a vibrant campus life.

---

🏫 Academics & Courses

The college offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Arts, Commerce, Science, Management, and Mass Media. The BMM, BMS, BSc (IT), and BCom programs are particularly popular. The teaching staff is experienced, approachable, and focused on concept-based learning rather than just rote study.

Internal assessments, projects, and presentations are given importance, helping students develop real-world skills. Many faculty members also help with career guidance and competitive exam prep.

---

🏢 Campus & Infrastructure

The campus is located in Vidyavihar (East), just a short walk from the railway station, which makes commuting very convenient. Classrooms are well-ventilated and equipped with projectors. The library is spacious and well-stocked, and there are computer labs, a media lab, seminar halls, and a clean canteen.

The college also provides Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and a peaceful atmosphere for studying. It shares its campus with other Somaiya institutions, giving students access to a larger community and more opportunities.

---

🌟 Activities & Campus Life

S K Somaiya encourages cultural events, fests, NSS, and student clubs. Events like Melange and various department fests provide platforms for talent. Students here enjoy a healthy balance between academics and extracurriculars.

The crowd is friendly, the campus is clean, and the vibe is progressive and safe—especially important for students moving to Mumbai from other cities.

---

✅ Pros

Excellent location (close to Vidyavihar Station)

Wide variety of courses and experienced faculty

Good campus with modern amenities

Strong focus on academics and extracurricular growth

Clean, disciplined, and student-friendly environment

---

⚠️ Suggestions for Improvement

The canteen can get crowded during lunch hours

More placements support in non-technical fields would be helpful

Some classrooms could benefit from AC in hotter months

---

📌 Final Verdict

S K Somaiya College is a great option for students looking for a well-rounded education in Mumbai. With strong academics, supportive faculty, and a great location, it offers an environment where students can grow both personally and professionally. Highly recommended for focused, ambitious students.
